q: Choose the correct passive form: ‘I have lost my wallet.’
o: My wallet had been lost
My wallet has been lost
My wallet was lost
My wallet is lost
e: মূল বাক্যটি present perfect tense (have lost)। কর্মবাচ্যে রূপান্তর করতে has/have been + past participle বসে। কর্তা I বাদ গিয়ে my wallet কর্তা হয় এবং has been lost হয়। অন্য অপশনে কাল বদলে গেছে: had been অতীত perfect, was অতীত আর is বর্তমান। তাই কাল ঠিক রাখতে হলে has been lost।

q: The passive voice of 'Panic seized me' is-
o: I was seized with panic
I was being seized by panic
I was seized by panic
I was seized from panic
e: seize, fill, cover, crowd ইত্যাদি ক্রিয়ার passive-এ অনেক সময় by-এর বদলে with বসে। তাই I was seized with panic। অর্থ: আতঙ্ক আমাকে গ্রাস করল। being যুক্ত অপশনটি continuous, তাই কাল মেলে না। from ভুল preposition। এই ধরনের প্রশ্নে by না বসিয়ে with বসাতে হয় কি না আগে দেখতে হয়।

q: The environment annoyed me. (Make it passive)
o: The environment makes annoyed me.
I am annoyed at the environment.
I annoyed at the environment.
I was annoyed at the environment.

q: Rewrite beginning with 'Rahim': 'The teacher gave Rahim a prize.'
o: Rahim was given by the teacher a prize to him.
Rahim was given a prize by the teacher.
Rahim has been given a prize by the teacher.
Rahim gave a prize by the teacher.
e:
যে ক্রিয়ার দুটি Object থাকে (give, send, show, tell, offer), সেখানে Passive দুভাবে করা যায়: ব্যক্তিকে Subject করে অথবা বস্তুকে Subject করে। এখানে Rahim দিয়ে শুরু করতে বলা হয়েছে, তাই Rahim was given a prize by the teacher। Tense Past Simple, তাই was given।
মনে রাখুন:
অন্য রূপ: A prize was given to Rahim by the teacher।

q: Which one is the correct passive?
o: By whom it is painted?
By whom it is painted with?
Who was it painted by?
With whom it is painted by?
e: Who painted it? বাক্যের passive-এ প্রথাগত রূপ By whom was it painted?, আর কথ্য ও আধুনিক ইংরেজিতে preposition শেষে নিয়ে বলা হয় Who was it painted by? প্রশ্নবাচক বাক্যে auxiliary was subject it-এর আগে বসে, যা গ-তে ঠিক আছে। ক ও খ-তে it is painted ক্রমটি বিবৃতির, প্রশ্নের নয়, আর খ-তে অতিরিক্ত with ভুল। ঘ-তে with whom এবং by একসঙ্গে বসায় অর্থ ও গঠন দুটিই ভুল। প্রশ্নবাচক passive-এ মূল কালের auxiliary (did থেকে was/were) ঠিক রাখতে হয়। একই নিয়মে Who broke the glass?-এর passive By whom was the glass broken?

q: Choose the correct passive form: "The manager signs all the letters personally."
o: All the letters is signed by the manager personally.
All the letters were signed by the manager personally.
All the letters are being signed by the manager personally.
All the letters are signed by the manager personally.

q: Which one is the passive voice form of 'Whom is he teaching Geography?'
o: Who is being taught Geography by him?
Is somebody taught Geography?
Who is teaching Geography?
Did he teach Geography?
e: Whom দিয়ে শুরু Present Continuous প্রশ্নের passive-এ Who + is + being + V3 + by + কর্তা বসে: Who is being taught Geography by him? অর্থ: সে কাকে ভূগোল পড়াচ্ছে? দ্বিতীয় অপশনে কর্তা ও continuous ভাব নেই। তৃতীয়টি active, আর চতুর্থটি Past কালের প্রশ্ন।

q: The correct passive form of “Who has written Hamlet?” is -
o: Hamlet has written by whom?
by who is Hamlet written? [JU (A) 13-14]
Who has Hamlet been written by?
by whom Hamlet is written?

q: The passive form of 'He pleases us'-
o: We were pleased with him.
We are pleased with him.
We are pleased by him.
We will be pleased by him.
e: Present indefinite তাই passive-এ ‘are + past participle’। ‘Please’ verb-এর passive-এ সাধারণত ‘by’-এর বদলে ‘with’ বসে: We are pleased with him.
s: কারিগরি শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, ক্যাশ সরকার ও অফিস সহায়ক (২০২১)

q: Choose the correct passive form of the sentence. He knew that his own life was unjust.
o: It was known that his own life was unjust
It was known to him that he was in a unjust life of his own
It was known that it was unjust his own life
It was known to him that his own life was unjust
e: Complex বাক্যের passive-এ মূল clause 'He knew' হয় 'It was known to him', আর that-clause অপরিবর্তিত থাকে: It was known to him that his own life was unjust। অর্থ: সে জানত তার নিজের জীবন অন্যায়পূর্ণ। প্রথম অপশনে to him বাদ পড়ায় কর্তা হারিয়ে গেছে। দ্বিতীয় ও তৃতীয় অপশনে অধীন clause বদলে গেছে।

q: Choose the correct passive voice: Active: He suggested giving up smoking.
o: He advised giving up smoking.
Giving up smoking were suggested by him.
Smoking should given up by him.
He suggested that smoking should be given up.

q: “Whom has he beaten?” The correct passive voice of this sentence is-
o: Who has been beaten by him?
You were beaten by whom?
By whom were you beaten?
By whom had you been beaten?

q: 'The man is climbing the cliff.' বাক্যটির Passive form হবে-
o: The cliff was being climbed by the man.
The cliff has been climbed by the man.
The cliff is being climbed by the man.
The cliff is climbed by the man.
e: Present continuous tense-এর passive গঠন হলো object + am/is/are + being + past participle, তাই The cliff is being climbed by the man। মূল বাক্যে is climbing আছে, আর passive-এ একই কাল রাখতে is being climbed লাগে। Was being climbed অতীত কাল, has been climbed present perfect, আর is climbed present indefinite, তাই এগুলো tense বদলে ফেলে। Voice পরিবর্তনে tense কখনো বদলায় না, শুধু সহায়ক verb-এর রূপ বদলায়। Past continuous-এর passive গঠন was/were + being + past participle, যেমন The letter was being written।

q: Passive Voice of ‘Someone pulled the bull violently’?
o: The bull had been pulled violently by someone
The bull had been pulled violently
The bull was pulled violently
The bull was to be pulled violent by someone
e: Past indefinite বাক্যের passive-এ 'was + past participle' বসে। কর্তা 'someone' অনির্দিষ্ট বলে 'by someone' সাধারণত বাদ দেওয়া হয়।
s: বাংলাদেশ সিকিউরিটিজ অ্যান্ড এক্সচেঞ্জ কমিশন, ব্যক্তিগত কর্মকর্তা (২০২১)

q: Choose the correct passive form of- ‘I have lost my wallet’
o: My wallet had been lost
My wallet has been lost
My wallet was lost
My wallet is lost
e:
Active বাক্যটি present perfect tense এ আছে (have lost)। Present perfect এর passive গঠন হলো object + has/have been + past participle। এখানে object my wallet singular, তাই has been বসবে এবং passive হবে My wallet has been lost (by me)। সাধারণত by me অংশটি বাদ দেওয়া হয়।
মনে রাখুন: Active বাক্যের tense passive এ বদলায় না। Had been হয় past perfect এর জন্য, আর was হয় past indefinite এর জন্য।
s: বাংলাদেশ কর্মচারী কল্যাণ বোর্ড, অফিস সহকারী কাম কম্পিউটার মুদ্রাক্ষরিক (২০২৬)

q: The passive form of the sentence 'Shoot the tiger' is-
o: Let the tiger be shoot
Let the tiger be shot
Let the tiger be shooted
Let the tiger be shotted
e:
আদেশসূচক বাক্যকে passive করতে 'Let + object + be + past participle' গঠন ব্যবহার করা হয়। 'Shoot the tiger' বাক্যে object 'the tiger' এবং shoot-এর past participle হলো shot। তাই passive রূপ হবে: Let the tiger be shot। প্রথম বিকল্পে shoot বসানো ভুল, কারণ be-এর পরে past participle লাগে। Imperative বাক্যকে passive করার এই নিয়মটি আলাদা, কারণ সাধারণ বাক্যের মতো is/are/was যোগ করে এখানে বদলানো যায় না। নিষেধসূচক বাক্যের ক্ষেত্রে Let not + object + be + past participle হয়। যেমন: Do not shoot the tiger. Passive: Let not the tiger be shot.
উদাহরণ: Open the door. Passive: Let the door be opened.
মনে রাখুন: shoot-shot-shot একটি অনিয়মিত verb। 'shooted' বা 'shotted' বলে কোনো রূপ নেই।
s: বাংলাদেশ সড়ক পরিবহন কর্তৃপক্ষ (বিআরটিএ), মোটরযান পরিদর্শক (২০২৩)

q: Whom did they hire for the vacant position? (Make it passive)
o: Whom was hired by them for the vacant position?
Who was hired by them for the vacant position?
Who did they hire for the vacant position?
Whom was hired for the vacant position by them?

q: Who has stolen the bag? [Passive Voice]
o: By whom has the bag been stolen?
By whom has the bag be stolen?
By whom has the bag to be stolen?
By whom has the bag being stolen?

q: They heard the baby cry. (make it passive)
o: The baby was heard crying by them.
The baby is heard to cry by them.
The baby was heard to cry by them.
The baby was heard to be cried by them.

q: 'It must have been broken by her.' (Make it active)
o: It was broken by her
She must have been broken by it
She must have broken it
She might have broken it

q: Does he always help his relatives? (Passive)
o: Are his relatives always helped by him?
Do his relatives always helped by him?
Were his relatives always helped by him?
Did his relatives always helped by him?

q: Change the voice of the sentence: One can achieve success by one’s sincere efforts.
o: Success can be achieved by sincere efforts.
One’s success can be achieved by one’s sincere efforts.
Success achieved by sincere efforts.
Someone's sincere efforts can be achieved by oneself.

q: Chose the correct passive voice: 'His attitude worried us'
o: We were worried with his attitude.
We have been worried by his attitude.
We were worried about his attitude.
We were worried by his attitude.

q: Last night I came to my house to find that the door ___.
o: had been broken
was broken
has been broken
is broken
e: আমি পৌঁছানোর আগেই দরজা ভাঙা হয়ে গিয়েছিল, অর্থাৎ অতীতের দুটি ঘটনার মধ্যে আগের ঘটনাটি past perfect-এ লিখতে হয়। দরজা নিজে ভাঙে না, কেউ ভাঙে, তাই passive: had been broken। অর্থ: গত রাতে বাড়ি ফিরে দেখলাম দরজা ভাঙা। was broken শুধু অতীত অবস্থা বোঝায়, আগের ঘটনা নয়। has been broken আর is broken বর্তমান বোঝায়, যা last night-এর সাথে মেলে না।

q: My uncle looks after me. The passive form is-
o: I was looked after by me uncle
I am looked after by my uncle
I am being looked after by my uncle
I am looking after by my uncle
e: Present Indefinite passive-এ am/is/are + V3 বসে, আর phrasal verb look after-এ after থেকে যায়: I am looked after by my uncle। অর্থ: আমার চাচা আমার দেখাশোনা করেন। প্রথম অপশনে was ও 'me uncle' দুটিই ভুল, তৃতীয়টি continuous, আর চতুর্থটি passive হয়নি।

q: The cat is running after the rat. (Choose the correct passive form)
o: The rat was being run after by the cat
The rat is being run after by the cat
The rat is run after by the cat
The cat is being run after by the rat
e: Present Continuous active-এর passive-এ am/is/are + being + V3 বসে, আর run after একটি phrasal verb তাই after থাকে: The rat is being run after by the cat। অর্থ: বিড়ালটি ইঁদুরের পিছনে ছুটছে। প্রথম অপশন Past Continuous, তৃতীয়টিতে being নেই, আর চতুর্থটিতে কর্তা-কর্ম উল্টে গেছে।

q: We were painting the house.(change the voice)
o: The house was being paint by us.
The house was being painted by us.
The house was been painted by us.
We were being painted the house.

q: Keep the door closed. (Change into passive voice)
o: Let the door be kept closed.
The door is kept closed.
The door has been kept closed.
The door is being kept closed.

q: The correct passive form of ''She fanned herself'' is-
o: Herself was fanned by she.
She herself fanned.
She was fanned by herself
Herself was fanned by her.

q: Choose the right form of bracket- in the books (to sell) yesterday.
o: All the books were sold yesterday
All the books had been sold yesterday
All the books are sold yesterday
All the books have been sold yesterday
e: Yesterday অতীতের নির্দিষ্ট সময় নির্দেশ করে, তাই বাক্যটি simple past tense-এ হবে, আর বই নিজে বিক্রি হয় না বলে passive voice লাগবে। Simple past passive-এর গঠন: was/were + past participle, তাই সঠিক বাক্য "All the books were sold yesterday"। "Have been sold" present perfect, যা yesterday-এর মতো নির্দিষ্ট অতীত সময়বাচক শব্দের সঙ্গে বসে না। "Had been sold" past perfect, যা অতীতের দুটি কাজের মধ্যে আগেরটি বোঝাতে লাগে, এখানে দ্বিতীয় কোনো কাজ নেই। "Are sold" present tense, তাই yesterday-এর সঙ্গে অসংগত। একই নিয়মে ago, last week, in 2010 থাকলেও simple past হয়।

q: Do you know them? (passive)
o: Are they known with you?
Do you know to them?
Are they known to you?
They be known by you?

q: A strong storm breaks the glass. What would be the passive form of voice?
o: The glass is broken by a strong storm.
A storm attacked the glass by window.
The glass has broken by a wind.
The glass has been broken by sudden storm.

q: Doesn’t Fortune favour the brave? (Make it Passive)
o: Aren’t the brave favoured by Fortune?
Isn’t the brave favoured by Fortune?
Don’t the brave are favoured by Fortune?
Don’t the brave be favoured by Fortune?

q: Choose the correct passive voice of 'Bring me a pen.'
o: Let a pen be brought by me
Let a pen be brought me
Let me be brought by a pen
Let a pen be brought for me
e: Bring-এর মতো ক্রিয়ার দুটি কর্ম থাকলে passive-এ প্রধান কর্মটি subject হয় এবং ব্যক্তির আগে for বসে: Let a pen be brought for me। অর্থ: আমার জন্য একটি কলম আনা হোক। প্রথম অপশনে by me ভুল, কারণ আদেশদাতা আর আনয়নকারী এক নয়। দ্বিতীয়টিতে for নেই, আর তৃতীয়টিতে অর্থ উল্টে গেছে।

q: Who is calling me?
o: By whom I am called?
By whom I am being called?
By whom am I being called?
By whom have I been called?
e: Who দিয়ে শুরু Present Continuous প্রশ্নের passive-এ By whom + am/is/are + object + being + V3 বসে, তাই By whom am I being called? অর্থ: আমাকে কে ডাকছে? প্রথম ও দ্বিতীয় অপশনে helping verb কর্তার আগে আসেনি। চতুর্থ অপশন Present Perfect, তাই কাল ভুল।

q: Passive form of 'Who spoke it?'
o: It was spoken by whom?
By whom was it spoken?
By whom it has spoken?
By whom it was spoken?
e: Who দিয়ে শুরু প্রশ্নের passive-এ By whom + was + object + V3 কাঠামো বসে, তাই By whom was it spoken? অর্থ: এটি কে বলেছিল? প্রশ্নে helping verb (was) কর্তার আগে আসে, তাই তৃতীয় ও চতুর্থ অপশন ভুল। প্রথম অপশনে প্রশ্নশব্দ শেষে বসেছে, যা সাধারণত গ্রহণযোগ্য নয়।

q: Which of the following is the correct passive voice form of the sentence "The coach taught the players a new strategy"?
o: A new strategy was taught to the coach by the players.
The coach was taught a new strategy to the players.
The players are taught a new strategy.
The players were taught a new strategy by the coach.

q: The company offers the employees a bonus. (change into passive voice)
o: The company are offered a bonus by the employees.
The company is offered a bonus by the employees.
The employees are offered a bonus by the company.
The employees was offered a bonus by the company.

q: The passive voice of 'Who is John inviting'?
o: Who is being invited by John?
Who is invited by John?
Whom is invites by John?
Is someone invited by John?
e:
প্রশ্নের বাক্যটি present continuous tense-এ লেখা, তাই এর passive করতে am/is/are-এর পরে being এবং তারপর main verb-এর past participle বসাতে হয়। ‘Who’ দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া প্রশ্নে কর্মের জায়গায় Who-ই থাকে, ফলে বাক্যটি দাঁড়ায় ‘Who is being invited by John?’। এখানে invite ক্রিয়ার past participle হলো invited। অন্য বিকল্পগুলোতে being বাদ পড়েছে, নয়তো ক্রিয়ার রূপ ভুল।
মনে রাখুন:
Present continuous passive-এর কাঠামো am/is/are + being + V3।
Past continuous passive-এর কাঠামো was/were + being + V3।

q: Let me do the sum. Passive of it is-
o: Let the sum is to be done by
Let the sum done by me
Let the sum being done by me
Let the sum be done by me
e: Let দিয়ে শুরু বাক্যের passive-এ Let + object + be + V3 + by + কর্তা বসে, তাই Let the sum be done by me। অর্থ: অঙ্কটি আমার দ্বারা করা হোক। প্রথম অপশন অসম্পূর্ণ আর অশুদ্ধ, দ্বিতীয়টিতে be নেই, আর তৃতীয়টিতে being ভুল। do-এর রূপ: do, did, done।

q: I remember my sister taking me to the museum.
o: I remember I was taken to the museum by my sister.
I remember being taken to the museum by my sister.
I remember taken to the museum by my sister.
I remember myself being taken to the museum.
e: Remember, like, hate, mind-এর পরে 'object + V-ing' থাকলে passive-এ রূপ হয় 'being + V3'। এখানে 'my sister taking me' হয়ে যায় 'being taken ... by my sister'। তাই উত্তর 'I remember being taken to the museum by my sister.'। অর্থ: আমার মনে আছে আমার বোন আমাকে জাদুঘরে নিয়ে গিয়েছিল। 'I remember taken' ভুল, কারণ being বাদ গেছে। একই কাঠামো: 'I hate people keeping me waiting' থেকে 'I hate being kept waiting'।

q: Don’t look down upon the poor. (Passive)
o: Let not the poor be looked down upon.
The poor is not looked down upon.
Let the poor be not looked down upon.
The poor are not looked down upon.

q: Identify the correct passive form : 'Let me write a letter.'
o: Let a letter be written by me.
Let a letter is written by me.
Let a letter to write by me.
Let a letter write by me.
e:
'Let' দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া বাক্যকে passive করতে হলে কাঠামো হয় Let + object + be + past participle। Let me write a letter বাক্যে কর্ম হলো a letter, তাই passive হবে Let a letter be written by me। অন্য অপশনগুলোতে be ব্যবহার না করে is, to write বা write বসানো হয়েছে, ফলে সেগুলো ব্যাকরণের দিক থেকে ভুল।
মনে রাখুন:
Let us help the poor. → Let the poor be helped by us.
Let-এর পরে সব সময় verb-এর base form বা be + past participle বসে, is/are বসে না।

q: Chocolate tastes sweet. (make it passive)
o: Chocolate is taste sweet.
Chocolate is sweet when it tastes.
Chocolate is sweet when it is tasted.
Sweet is the tastes of chocolate.

q: Identify the correct passive form of the sentence : "Who will do the work?"
o: Whom the work will be done?
By whom will the work be done?
Who the work will be done by?
By who the work will be done?
e:
Active voice-এর Who will do the work? বাক্যটিকে passive করলে ‘Who’ বদলে ‘By whom’ হয়, কারণ passive-এ কর্তা by-এর পরে বসে এবং object-form ‘whom’ লাগে। Active-এর will do হয়ে passive-এ will be done। তাই শুদ্ধ রূপ: By whom will the work be done?
মনে রাখুন: Will/shall থাকলে passive-এ will be/shall be + past participle বসে।
s: বাংলাদেশ রেলওয়ে, উপসহকারী প্রকৌশলী ও অন্যান্য পদ (২০২৪)

q: He decided to leave the job. Which one is the correct passive?
o: The job was decided to be left him. সে চাকরিটি/কাজটি ছেড়ে
He decided the job to be left. দেওয়ার সিদ্ধান্ত নিল
He decided the job should be left.
The job should be left was decided by him.

q: Identify the correct passive from of 'Who did this'?
o: By whom was this done?
By whom has this done?
By whom this has been done?
By whom this had been done?
e:
Active voice বাক্য ‘Who did this?’-এ who কর্তা এবং verb হলো Past Indefinite (did)। Who দিয়ে শুরু প্রশ্নবাচক বাক্যকে passive করতে হলে ‘By whom’ দিয়ে শুরু করে auxiliary verb আগে বসাতে হয়। Past Indefinite-এর passive-এ was বা were লাগে এবং মূল verb-এর past participle (done) হয়। তাই উত্তর: By whom was this done? বাকি বিকল্পগুলোতে auxiliary verb ভুল জায়গায় আছে অথবা tense মেলেনি।
মনে রাখুন:
Who wrote the letter? → By whom was the letter written?
Who is doing the work? → By whom is the work being done?

q: Do not beat the dog (make it passive)
o: Let not the dog be beaten.
Let not the dog beaten.
Let the dog being beaten.
Let be not the dog beaten.

q: I gave Inaaya a painting book. (Make it passive)
o: A painting book was given to Inaaya by me.
Inaaya was given a painting book by me.
Inaaya was to given a painting book by me.
Both A + B

q: They are going to build a new bridge. (Make it passive)
o: A new bridge has going to be built by them.
A new bridge is going to been built by them.
A new bridge is going to being built by them.
A new bridge is going to be built by them.

q: 'I saw the boy crying'- বাক্যের সঠিক Passive form-
o: The boy is seen crying by me
The boy cry was seen by me
The boy was seen crying by me
The boy crying was seen by me
e: Past indefinite-এর passive-এ was/were + past participle বসে। Object 'the boy' subject হবে এবং 'crying' অংশটি past participle-এর পরে থাকবে: The boy was seen crying by me।

q: While writing a CV, I should start all bullet points with-
o: Responsible for
I…
A verb such ‘managed’
None of the above

q: The passive form of 'We called him a fool' is—
o: He had been called a fool by us.
He was called a fool by us.
He is called a fool by us.
He has been called a fool by us.
e:
‘We called him a fool’ বাক্যে him হলো object, আর a fool তার সম্পূরক। Past Indefinite Tense-এর passive-এ object subject হয়ে বসে, তারপর was/were এবং verb-এর past participle আসে। তাই ‘He was called a fool by us’। সম্পূরক a fool আগের মতোই থাকে। বাকি অপশনগুলোতে Past Perfect বা Present Perfect বসেছে, যা মূল বাক্যের কালের সঙ্গে মেলে না।
মনে রাখুন: Past Indefinite-এর passive গঠন: Subject + was/were + past participle + by + object।
উদাহরণ: They elected him captain. = He was elected captain.
s: জাতীয় জনসংখ্যা গবেষণা ও প্রশিক্ষণ ইনস্টিটিউট (নিপোর্ট), হোম ইকোনমিস্ট (২০২৪)

q: 'Spread a mat on it.' The passive of it is-
o: A mat should be spread on it
A mat should have been spread on it by you
A mat be spread on it
Have a mat spread on it
e: Spread, put up ইত্যাদি ক্রিয়ায় শুরু imperative-এর passive-এ কখনো Let-এর বদলে Have ব্যবহার করা হয়: Have a mat spread on it। অর্থ: এর ওপর একটি মাদুর বিছিয়ে দাও (বিছানোর ব্যবস্থা করো)। এটি বইয়ের বিশেষ নিয়ম। should যুক্ত অপশনগুলো আদেশের বদলে উপদেশ বোঝায়।

q: 'Never tell a lie.' The passive form of this sentence is
o: Let never a lie be told
Let not a lie never be told
Let a lie never be told
Let lie never be told
e: Never দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া আদেশে Let + never + object + be + V3 কাঠামো ব্যবহার হয়। তাই 'Never tell a lie' হয় 'Let never a lie be told.'। অর্থ: কখনো মিথ্যা বলো না। 'not ... never' একসঙ্গে বসালে double negative হয়ে যায়, তাই দ্বিতীয় অপশন ভুল। 'Let lie never be told'-এ article a নেই। মনে রাখুন, Don't-এর passive 'Let not', আর Never-এর passive 'Let never' বা 'Let ... never'।

q: English is – in many countries. (অনেক দেশে ইংরেজি ভাষা বলা হয়)
o: spoken
spoke
speaking
speaks
e: ইংরেজি ভাষা মানুষ বলে, ভাষা নিজে বলে না, তাই এখানে passive voice লাগে: English is spoken in many countries। Passive-এর গঠন be + past participle, আর speak-এর past participle spoken। spoke হলো past tense, তাই is spoke ভুল। speaking বসালে is speaking হয় active continuous, যার অর্থ যেন ইংরেজি নিজে কথা বলছে, আর is speaks দুটি ক্রিয়ার ভুল জোড়া। speak ক্রিয়ার তিন রূপ speak, spoke, spoken, যা passive-এর প্রশ্নে প্রায়ই লাগে।

q: The company is going to announce the new policy. (Make it passive)
o: The new policy is going to be announced by the company.
The new policy was going to be announced by the company.
The new policy is gone to be announced by the company.
The new policy is being going to be announced by the company.

q: People always respect the freedom-fighters. (Make it Passive)
o: The freedom-fighters are always respected.
The freedom-fighters are always being respected.
People are always respected by the freedom-fighters.
The freedom-fighters will always be respected by all.

q: Whe I am alone, I hear the footsteps of my friend in my imagination.
o: The footsteps of my friend are heard by me when I am alone
The footsteps of my friend was heard by me when I am alone.
The footsteps of my friend is heard by me When I am alone.
The footsteps of my friend heard by me, when I am alone
e: কর্মবাচ্যে রূপান্তর: The footsteps of my friend are heard by me when I am alone। মূল বাক্য প্রেজেন্ট ইনডেফিনিট (I hear), তাই কর্মবাচ্যে am/is/are + past participle হবে, আর নতুন কর্তা 'The footsteps' বহুবচন বলে are। 'was heard' অতীত কাল আনে এবং বচনও ভুল, 'is heard' বহুবচন কর্তার সঙ্গে মেলে না, আর ঘ অপশনে সহকারী ক্রিয়াই নেই। সময়বাচক খণ্ড 'when I am alone' অপরিবর্তিত থাকে, কারণ কর্মবাচ্য করা হয় শুধু প্রধান খণ্ডের। প্রকৃত বাক্যে 'in my imagination' অংশটিও থাকা উচিত ছিল, তবে অপশনগুলোর মধ্যে ক অপশনেই ক্রিয়ার কাল ও বচন ঠিক আছে।

q: The correct passive voice of 'Never do this' -
o: Let this ever be done.
Let not this ever done.
Let not this be done.
Let never be this done.
